easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a permanent that shares a type with the one you intend to donate.
description:
Activate Gauntlets of Chaos by paying {5} and sacrificing it, exchanging control of (and destroying all Auras attached to) a permanent an opponent controls and Surrak.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Surrak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
